text: Based on the output from the NASA FIRMS dataset, there were no fire or thermal anomaly detections on the property (ASSET-F04) during the period from October 4, 2026, to November 3, 2026. The sensors VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, and MODIS covered the asset throughout this period, and no detections intersected with the asset. Therefore, we can confirm that there was no burning on this property during the specified period.
